summary: Astraeos 1.0 Heaven & Abyss includes separate sea-surface and underwater Kraken encounters, guardians and minibosses. Prepare both land and sea teams.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.

steps.title: 1 · Land encounters and minibosses
steps.reason: Prepare separately for Medusa, Colossus and the other minibosses; they are not one combined arena.

steps.title: 2 · Two Kraken encounters
steps.reason: Have diving equipment, spare gear and controlled sea tames ready. Sea-surface and underwater Kraken are separate encounters.

steps.title: 3 · Guardian requirements
steps.reason: Hydraskos the Unbroken, Manticore and Medusa have their own requirements. Tribute and army thresholds are not verified here; do not directly copy the Scorched Manticore setup.
